clauses.actor_role: licensee, end users, and third parties whom the licensee allows
clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, and Links. Prohibits caching, framing, syndicating, reselling, analyzing, training on, or otherwise learning from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; also prohibits extracting or collecting any of those components for another purpose, including the specified automated collection, indexing, crawling, or scraping examples.
clauses.condition_explanation: grounded_results_or_search_suggestions_or_links means the identified Search grounding components; the specific extraction prohibition also covers Links.

obligation_items.content: Do not cache, frame, syndicate, resell, analyze, train on, or otherwise learn from Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, or extract or collect any identified component for another purpose.
obligation_items.actor: licensee; end users and third parties whom the licensee allows
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, or Links
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Grounding with Google Search, except where a specific permission in lines 249–276 applies to the particular action and material.

clauses.actor_role: licensee, end users, and third parties whom the licensee allows
clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: default prohibition on copying or storing Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, subject to the specific permissions in lines 249–271; line 244 also prohibits implementing click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring, subject to the interface-monitoring permission in lines 273–276.
clauses.condition_explanation: grounded_results_or_search_suggestions means the identified Search grounding content. The separately stated tracking/monitoring prohibition is limited by its exception at lines 273–276.

obligation_items.content: Do not copy or store Grounded Results or Search Suggestions except as permitted by the specific exceptions in lines 249–271; do not implement click tracking, Link-tracking, or other monitoring except as permitted by lines 273–276.
obligation_items.actor: licensee; end users and third parties whom the licensee allows
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using Grounding with Google Search; the specified copy/store and interface-monitoring exceptions apply on their stated terms.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission to copy and store the specified text of Grounded Results for one of the listed purposes. The two-year limit applies to the listed storage permission; the function-call path is temporary and subject to its distinct conditions.
clauses.condition_explanation: The three purposes are alternatives, not cumulative requirements. For the function-call alternative, all stated interim-use, deletion, and final-display conditions apply.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission to copy and store Grounded Results and Search Suggestions solely to comply with applicable law or regulations, for the minimum time necessary.
clauses.condition_explanation: Both the exclusive compliance purpose and minimum-necessary retention limit are required.

clauses.actor_role: licensee permitting end users to copy and store
clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permission concerns individual Grounded Results displayed to end users through the application, subject to both access/collection and database restrictions.
clauses.condition_explanation: All listed conditions apply to the end-user copy-and-store permission.

obligation_items.content: Ensure permitted end-user copies and stored results are not accessible or collected by automated or programmatic means and are not used to create a database.
obligation_items.object: individual Grounded Results displayed to end users through the application
obligation_items.trigger: When allowing end users to copy or store those results.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: permits monitoring interactions with the application interface but not tracking whether interactions were specifically with a given Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
clauses.condition_explanation: The permission is for general interface interaction monitoring; the specific-content tracking exclusion applies to each identified content item or Link.

obligation_items.content: Do not track whether end-user interactions were specifically with a given Grounded Result, Search Suggestion, or Link, in whole or part.
obligation_items.object: end-user interactions with Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, or Links
obligation_items.trigger: When monitoring end-user interactions with the application interface.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search: absent Google's written permission, prohibits modifying or interspersing other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions, and prohibits specified interference with presentation or navigation from Links or Search Suggestions to associated destination pages.
clauses.condition_explanation: google_has_not_permitted_in_writing is false if Google has given written permission. The restrictions concerning interstitial content, redirects, and inhibited destination-page display concern Links or Search Suggestions and associated destination pages.

obligation_items.content: Do not modify or intersperse other content with Grounded Results or Search Suggestions; do not place interstitial content between a Link or Search Suggestion and its associated destination page, redirect end users away from that page, or minimize, remove, or otherwise inhibit its full and complete display.
obligation_items.object: Grounded Results, Search Suggestions, Links, and associated destination pages
obligation_items.trigger: Unless Google has permitted the conduct in writing.

clauses.scope_note: Grounding with Google Search data-use provision: Google states it will store prompts, provided contextual information, and output for 30 days to create Grounded Results and Search Suggestions; stored information can be used for debugging and testing. For use via paid Gemini API quota, debugging/testing processing is in accordance with the identified Data Processing Addendum. This records Google's stated service processing, not a grant of data rights to the licensee.
clauses.condition_explanation: The 30-day storage and stated purposes apply when using Grounding with Google Search. The Data Processing Addendum qualification applies to debugging and testing processing when using paid Gemini API quota. The referenced addendum is not supplied, so its terms cannot be specified.

obligation_items.content: Store prompts, provided contextual information, and output for 30 days for creation of Grounded Results and Search Suggestions; stored information may be used for debugging and testing of supporting systems, with paid-quota debugging/testing processing governed by the referenced Data Processing Addendum.
obligation_items.object: prompts, contextual information provided, and output associated with Grounding with Google Search
obligation_items.trigger: When Grounding with Google Search is used; the Data Processing Addendum qualification applies to debugging and testing via paid Gemini API quota.

coverage_notes: The Google APIs Terms, API Terms, applicable Google Cloud payment terms, Documentation, Data Processing Addendum, and Client Application Guidelines are incorporated or referenced but not supplied here; their contents are not inferred.
